data.define: Used for things with a beautiful, matching look.

misuse.text: Don't call your messy room 'aesthetic' to Mom.
misuse.why: It only fits stylish, pretty things.

native.tip: “aesthetic” = estético. Exemplo: “Your desk looks so aesthetic.”
native.caption:
O que significa “aesthetic”?
“aesthetic” = estético.
Exemplo: “Your desk looks so aesthetic.” (Sua escrivaninha está tão "aesthetic".)
